reproduce.title: CmdPal: Grid view is sensitive to preview pane timing
prerequisites: Use a controlled test machine and a disposable extension fixture. Coordinate with assigned maintainer jiripolasek.
steps: 1. Prepare a disposable grid/gallery extension with identical items; have one item supply details immediately and another supply the same details after a controlled delay.
2. Record the exact dev revision, window size, grid size and details-pane setting. Navigate between immediate/delayed items and back while loading is pending.
3. Compare details-pane visibility/reserved width, item positions and selected item before/during/after loading; repeat with an item that genuinely has no details.
4. Agree with the assigned owner whether the pane should reserve width while loading; keep the genuinely absent-details case distinct and capture a short before/during/after recording.
reproduce.version_requirement: Record the exact0.102 development revision and compare a current build; do not treat a source read as runtime validation.
reproduce.expected_result: Delayed content must not cause unintended grid/gallery reflow or lose selection; genuinely absent details must still follow the agreed pane policy.
